name: VSN F-104G/S Starfighter
summary: VSN team's free F-104G and F-104S Starfighter (incl. air-to-ground versions) for DCS World.
description:
Free VSN mod adding the F-104G and Italian F-104S Starfighter, each with an air-to-ground version, and many skin packs. Flyable with the FC3 (F-15C/Su-27-style) cockpit, or as AI without FC3.

VSN's downloads are on pCloud and ask for a password; VSN publishes it on their download index: `VSNROX`.

Requires: Flyable only with Flaming Cliffs 3 installed; otherwise usable as AI.
license: Free, private use only, commercial use prohibited (VSN terms)
